name: Canoweissmon

rulings.answer: No, it can't. This effect can only be used to digivolve from a Digimon whose card name is [Gammamon] and also has a digivolution card with [Gammamon]. Note that digivolutions from cards with non-[Gammamon] card names are possible using digivolution requirements or this card's special digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: Does this card's "This card in your hand can digivolve onto one of your [Gammamon] that has a digivolution card with [Gammamon] for a digivolution cost of 3, ignoring this card's digivolution requirements" mean that it can also digivolve from cards that have [Gammamon] such as [BetelGammamon], [KausGammamon], [WezenGammamon], or [GulusGammamon]?

rulings.answer: Yes, they activate. This card's ""This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in this Digimon's digivolution cards"" effect is an [All Turns] effect, so it will activate as soon as the digivolution is confirmed. Therefore, [When Digivolving] effects are gained and will trigger.
rulings.question: When digivolving into this card, do the [When Digivolving] effects on digivolution cards with [Gammamon] activate?

rulings.answer: Yes, if the memory gauge is now at 1 or greater on your opponent's side, you can activate ＜Blitz＞ .
rulings.question: I digivolve a Digimon with [Gammamon] and a [When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ effect into this card. Can I activate the [When Digivolving] ＜Blitz＞ effect through this card's [All Turns] effect and attack?
Can I digivolve one of my [Gammamon] with a digivolution card with [Gammamon] in the battle area into this card in the hand when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?

rulings.answer: No, this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect don't affect the inherited effects of digivolution cards with [Gammamon].
rulings.question: Does this card's [All Turns] effect and inherited effect allow me to activate the inherited effect of a digivolution card with [Gammamon] as an effect of this card?
